mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (email, password_hash, nickname, role) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member WHERE email = #{email}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dual
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member WHERE nickname = #{nickname}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dual
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET nickname = #{nickname} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE member SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE member SET role = #{role} WHERE id = #{id}
